variants.selection: both reported; no truth-based choice or fallback

marker.corner_refinement: OpenCV default, same as prepared contract
marker.canonical_id: first accepted actually decoded ID; no private expected-ID map

triangulation.algorithm: frozen robust_triangulate; deterministic <=40 hypotheses, no track reconciliation
triangulation.input_point: persisted predicted native-mask centroid; no true center

estimator_allowlist: persisted predicted masks centroids and track IDs

evaluation.camera_pose: camera center in marker coordinates and geodesic orientation; evaluated privately per frame and phase
evaluation.calyx_reference: center of evaluated world-axis-aligned calyx bounding box, transformed into marker coordinates; engineering geometry reference, not internal fruit center or 6D fruit pose
evaluation.identity_matching: same global confidence-ordered class-agnostic native-mask IoU>=0.5; no distance-based truth selection; arithmetic checked against completed detection confusion per frame
evaluation.strict_attribution: at least 3 inlier observations, every inlier matched, all matched to the same true instance; mixed/unmatched retained as unassigned negative
evaluation.errors_all_matched_inliers: also report distances for every inlier having a 2D match, including mixed tracks; separate from strict attribution
evaluation.coverage: unique true instances localized / unique visible instances in scope; no counting duplicates as extra coverage
evaluation.phase: inspection separated from transit; phase-specific pose errors

limitations: Uncalibrated independent sensor noise, no bias or correlated drift
Single common frontal marker; C07 has no separate marker
Fragmented frozen track IDs; no tracker correction
Visible-mask centroids can shift with viewpoint and occlusion
Calyx AABB center is a geometric reference; no claim of internal fruit pose
Synthetic validation plants, no external holdout
